subject.title: fix(plugins): bound marketplace manifest file reads

question: Should marketplace manifests larger than 16 MiB become unsupported for local, known-marketplace, and cloned remote sources?
rationale: The implementation safely enforces the proposed limit, but repository behavior and docs do not currently define a maximum manifest size, so accepting this new failure boundary requires owner intent.

options.title: Accept 16 MiB boundary
options.body: Adopt 16 MiB as the permanent marketplace manifest limit and land the proven patch once required checks finish.

options.title: Choose another limit
options.body: Set an owner-approved threshold, update the constant and boundary tests, and document it if users need to design around the value.

options.title: Pause the hard limit
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers define a different bounded-loading policy that avoids rejecting legitimate large manifests.

recommendation.title: Accept 16 MiB boundary
recommendation.body: Adopt 16 MiB as the permanent marketplace manifest limit and land the proven patch once required checks finish.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the marketplace loading contract and are the strongest available owner for its compatibility boundary.
